day_summary: SATURDAY NIGHT UPDATE — US MARKETS CLOSED ALL SESSION; $152.15 LAST CLOSE; BOND DISTRIBUTION DAY 5 (NO TRADING); NASDAQ 100 INCLUSION JULY 7 EXPECTED; STEP ASIDE UNCHANGED. No US equity trading June 27 (Saturday). SPCX last traded at $152.15 (June 26, −0.50% from $152.91). Bond distribution continues: formal settlement was June 26 (Day 4 of distribution); business day count from settlement restarts Monday June 29 as Day 1 post-settlement, with clearance est. July 7–10 (10–12 business days from settlement). CRITICAL NEW CATALYST: SpaceX expected to join the Nasdaq 100 on July 7 (the same day as the estimated bond distribution clearance), which would generate approximately $4.3B in systematic passive inflows from QQQ, QQQM, and other Nasdaq 100-tracking funds. This is a second one-time structural passive buying event — separate from the Russell 1000 addition (June 26) — that creates a near-term price catalyst coinciding with the bond distribution clearance window. HOWEVER: the step-aside posture is UNCHANGED. The $4.3B Nasdaq 100 inflow is a one-time passive event, not a structural demand shift. The bond distribution mechanics remain the dominant near-term supply force. The re-entry gate ($185, two consecutive closes above, on above-average volume, after distribution clears) is unchanged. Volume below 5M shares/day sustained for 2–3 sessions remains the clearance signal.

analysis:
## Technical analysis (Saturday June 27 — weekend review, no US trading)

**No US equity trading June 27 (Saturday).** Last traded price: $152.15 (June 26 close, −0.50%).

**Bond distribution pace:** Day 4 volume 126.91M shares — declining from peak distribution estimate of 200–300M+ shares. Pace consistent with July 7–10 clearance. June 29 (Day 5, first post-settlement session) volume is the next data point.

**IG floor:** Held on close for four consecutive sessions despite two intraday breaches ($147.11 and $148.51). Closing support is structural — IG-rating-floor defense desks and underwriter stabilization buying are providing the bid.

**Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7:** New catalyst that creates a $4.3B passive inflow on the expected clearance date — favorable timing. But the same distribution mechanics that absorbed the Russell 1000 reconstitution premium will apply. Do not count on single-session passive inclusion to clear the $185 re-entry gate.

**Key June 29 reads:** (1) Volume (normalization signal); (2) IG floor close vs. $150 (breach watch); (3) Pre-positioning signals from QQQ inclusion buyers (above-average volume with upward bias, uncharacteristic of distribution selling).

**Re-entry gate:** $185 two consecutive closes + above-average volume + confirmed distribution clearance. September 2 first earnings is the structural catalyst for a full position size.
